svg.aria-label: you've found the workshop. the polished version lives at rishabhsingh.tech, this is where the code, the experiments and the late-night side projects live. most of it is flutter and dart, with a growing pile of next.js, typescript and aws experiments. i like small, fast tools, clean apis and apps that feel instant. if something here helps you, a star goes a long way. found a bug or have an idea? open an issue or a pr, contributions welcome.
